sources.snippet: CompressAI (compress-ay) is a PyTorch library and evaluation platform for end-to-end compression research. CompressAI currently provides: custom operations, layers and models for deep learning based data compression a partial port of the official TensorFlow compression library pre-trained end-to-end compression models for learned image compression evaluation scripts to compare learned models ...
